decisions.reason: Ailee's tutorial hand-off to Rorian; opens the whole Thendal Grove chain.
Eight Juvenile Vuldrens beside the watchtower; opens the class quests. Leather bracers reward.
Pesky Cirrusflies beside the Vuldrens; first half of the Cirrusfly Queen chain.
Cirrusfly Queen, a lone level 3 mob; the three armour rewards are the first real gear choice.
Elemental Unrest: speak to Yala Windwatcher; opens Agitators and the Al'Aketh chain.
Agitators: Roiling Winds and Al'Aketh Converts beside Yala, levels 2-3; leads to Return to Rorian.
Shaman Call of Earth part 1: Signet of Akir drops from the Al'Aketh Converts that Agitators already clears.
Shaman Call of Earth part 2: drink the Earth Sapta at the Minor Manifestation of Earth.
Shaman Call of Earth part 3: rewards the Earth Totem, a core Shaman tool.
Return to Rorian closes the Yala chain; the belt and cloak are small armour rewards.
Foul Matriarch: 8 Ursera Scavengers and Urs'anah's head, five weapon rewards; unlocks The Next Step.
Aetheen of the Gales: speaking quest that gates the Ursera chain (Foul Matriarch, Aggressive Encroachment).
The Next Step: report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village, the second hub, which opens the Highlands.
Scrawny Ursera claws at levels 3-4 beside the Ursera den; three Thendal Ranger armour pieces.
Stunt quest at the Thendal watchtower with no mobs. Needs the Walk on Air ability; no XP data.
Hunter first class quest (read the Scribbled Note, speak to Tai'ree Farsight).
Rogue first class quest (read the Simple Note, speak to Akeri Duskblade).
Shaman first class quest (examine the Humming Recall Crystal, speak to Windshaper Boro).
Druid first class quest (read the Folded Parchment, speak to Xyton Silverwind).
Welcome to Shen'dar Village: speak to Illaya and Coriella; gate for the Highlands quests and the inn.
10 Prideclaw Pelts from the level 5-6 Prideclaws; reward is the Simple Leather Satchel, the first bag.
Hippogryph Protectors and the Matriarch are level 6-7, two to three above a level 4-5 player. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Highlands Bandits and Badwind Bennic are level 7, too high at the level 5 exit. Handed to zephras_05-10 with the bandit camp.
Warrior first class quest (read the Crumpled Note, seek out Blademaster Ren).
Al'Aketh Thugs: 6 Brutes, 4 Neophytes and Malduko (level 4-5) in the west camp beside Hanaa Nightwind.
Galestrider eggs and strider meat on the south patch with the Prideclaws; food reward on the way.
Chain head of Meddlesome Mages. The mage rewards need level 10 and 16. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence beside Yala. Only if you have Skysight; no XP data.
Pilfered Windstones drop from the same level 7 bandit camp as The Criminal Element. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Gather Windstone Clusters beside the Vuldren patch; cheap and on the way. Low-value rewards.
Hippogryph Down from the level 6-7 hippogryphs in the south-west. Handed to zephras_05-10 with Hippogryph Harassment.
High Order Apprentices (levels 5-6) with Idol (needs level 16) and Totem (needs level 10) rewards. Handed to zephras_05-10.
Halaan's gift to view the anchor pylon: a quick talk at the watchtower; no rewards, no XP data.
Camping quest from Raan: sit at his campfire for Boosted Rest. The DB campfire positions are off the isle.
Breadcrumb from Aetheen to Raan in Shen'dar Village, after Foul Matriarch. Leads to The Great Outdoors.
